preheader: Tech valuations dip, Berkshire buys back $9.6B in stock, and UCI's 7'9 center makes history.

lead.headline: Tech Stocks Fall Below S&P 500 Valuation for First Time Since 2017
lead.body: Chip stocks fell nearly 30% over the last five weeks following recent market swings. While tech took a hit, the broader S&P 500 remained largely flat. Tech stocks are now trading at a lower valuation than the rest of the market for the first time in nine years.
lead.why: When tech valuations drop below broader market averages, it resets pricing expectations across venture capital and impacts valuation models you will study in corporate finance.

stories.headline: Berkshire Hathaway Expands Buybacks Despite Earnings Drop
stories.body: Berkshire Hathaway reported a 6% drop in third-quarter operating earnings to $12.7 billion due to weaker insurance underwriting. Despite the lower profits, the Greg Abel-led company spent $9.6 billion buying back its own stock during the quarter.
stories.why: Analyzing how major holding companies deploy excess cash during profit downturns gives you practical context for corporate valuation and treasury strategy.

stories.headline: Spectrum Cable Parent Cuts $2 Billion After Subscriber Loss
stories.body: Charter Communications is launching an overhaul to cut $2 billion in costs over the next 18 months. The move comes after the company reported losing 233,000 internet subscribers during the third quarter.
stories.why: Understanding major corporate turnarounds and aggressive cost reduction programs is essential preparation for consulting case studies.

stories.headline: Anthropic Uses AI to Speed Up AI Model Development
stories.body: Anthropic is using its existing artificial intelligence to build its next generation of models. The internal automation has doubled the speed of model improvements over the past year, even as the company publicly advocates for slowing down development.
stories.why: AI-driven development speeds up product cycles, lowering the technical hurdle for software startups.

stories.headline: Nvidia CEO Targeted in Chinese Intelligence Operation
stories.body: US officials reported that China's intelligence agency recruited an executive at data center firm Megaspeed to target Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang. The revelation underscores rising national security concerns around semiconductor leadership.
stories.why: Geopolitical risks directly affect semiconductor supply chains and hardware startup planning.

stories.headline: McKinsey Urges Companies to Overhaul Cybersecurity for AI Era
stories.body: A new McKinsey report states that businesses must rebuild their cybersecurity strategies as frontier AI tools make it faster for attackers to find software vulnerabilities. The firm recommends rising investments in automated threat detection.
stories.why: Consulting firms build major service practices around emerging technology risks, pointing to key areas for future advisory roles.

stories.headline: Deloitte Finds 28% of Companies See AI Revenue Growth
stories.body: Deloitte reported that 28% of surveyed businesses now see direct revenue growth from AI investments, up from 20% earlier this year. However, many executives still lack clear data on which specific AI tools generate those returns.
stories.why: Measuring return on tech spending is a core task for management consultants and corporate strategy teams.

stories.headline: Olivier Rioux Stars in UC Irvine Debut Victory
stories.body: 7-foot-9 center Olivier Rioux made his debut for UC Irvine on Tuesday, recording 13 points and 12 rebounds in 18 minutes. The Anteaters defeated Chapman 92-66 in their season opener at the Bren Events Center.

stories.headline: Rafael Jodar Qualifies for ATP World Tour Finals
stories.body: 20-year-old Rafael Jodar secured his spot in the season-ending ATP World Tour Finals in Turin. The achievement comes during his debut season on the ATP Tour.

term.name: Share Repurchase
term.definition: When a company buys back its own stock from the open market using available cash. This reduces the number of shares outstanding, increasing each remaining share's slice of ownership and boosting earnings per share. Berkshire Hathaway made news today by repurchasing $9.6 billion of its stock in Q3.

serve.headline: Zipline raised $1.5B at a $21.5B valuation for drone delivery
serve.body: Drone delivery startup Zipline raised $1.5 billion in new capital as Walmart prepares to scale drone shipping. The financing values the autonomous logistics company at $21.5 billion.
